details:
- CVE-2026-29518: re-implement the "use chroot = no" confinement after the
  centos7els fix: every path operation proves its parent directory beneath
  the pinned module root through /proc/self/fd and runs on it with the
  *at() calls.  In-module symlinks, directories the daemon uid may search
  but not read, -L/-K and --link-dest=../dir keep working; xattrs, ACLs and
  timestamps are confined too.  Drop CVE-2026-29518-2.patch
- CVE-2026-43619: chmod no longer follows a leaf symlink; CVE-2026-29518:
  confined calls act on the resolved object with O_NOFOLLOW
- CVE-2026-29518: anchor the receiver's basis open at the pinned working
  directory and prove it beneath the module, not beneath a root resolved
  by name
- CVE-2026-53784, CVE-2026-53786, CVE-2026-53793: re-anchor on the
  re-implemented CVE-2026-29518 confinement
